name: Chicken Salad with Cucumbers, Peaches, Mint, Goat Cheese & Almonds
ingredients: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Place chicken on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl. Add almonds, vinaigrette, salt, and pepper, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
